newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELASTO BUYS RUUVIPOJAT FOR FIM 6.9 MLN.
newsitem.headline: HELASTO BUYS RUUVIPOJAT FOR FIM 6.9 MLN.

text.p: Finnish security device manufacturer Suomen Helasto Oy said on Tuesday it had bought nuts and bolts wholesaler and retailer Ruuvipojat Oy for 6.9 million markka.
"Suomen Helasto has bought all of Ruuvipojat Oy's share capital from the owner Veikko Laamanen on April 8," Suomen Helasto said in a statement.
Suomen Helasto said it would pay 14.5 percent of the 6.9 million markka acquisition price in Suomen Helasto shares, giving Laamanen 1.5 percent of the company.
Ruuvipojat's net sales in the year ended June 30, 1996 totalled 7.5 million markka.
